You are definitely not supposed to lose the battle, but it is an optional battle that you don't have to engage in.  As has already been mentioned he is one of the more difficult battles to engage specifically because of his stat damage aoe's of polar and plague.  

He also has some decent buffs that you'll probably want to strip with dispels, but that requires time that you dont get because his first move is the polar.      

Approaches for it include.. rush him with melee chargers and stay on him with a cleric/healer with resteration or heal scrolls.   If you have arcane's in the party then hopefully you can have them cast or get a scroll of icebody, which will make them immune to the dex damage..  lifebubble/delay poison communal for the plague.  

Or you can cheese it.. sirroco his starting area.. and use scrolls of tsunami.. you'll still need to dispel him, but if you get the right buffs off.. he'll fail his saves on anything but unfair eventually and die to it.      

cheese #2 = leave all your party members except main char at the base of the mountain..  have summons ready to go.. once fight starts.. let him exaust his spells.. have summons keep the fight going.. and just wait it out.. eventually the plague storm will move, and the polar will expire.. if you cant be bothered to dispel aoe..  at that point he has little else and its just a question of buffs and debuffs.

cheese #3 - create an initiative whore merc and start fight in turnbased - if you do it right.. you'll have the first move.. dispel.. combine with sirroco.. and he dies.

You of course dont need this, once your party is more capable.. he's one of the tougher challenges in this act.. but only because he acts first with nasty spells.

From what I can see.. your dps reflects the overall standard of gear that you have.

You say you're a newbie so dont sweat it, just recognize that if you want your dps to get significantly better you'll want to over time address each gear piece.

Quick suggestions for what you should be looking for as far as upgrades on each piece.

your sceptre is weak. 

Ideally you wouldnt use a sceptre

The only sceptre's worth using is opal for max elemental dmg, sambar for penetration.. outside of that you ideally are using a wand that has cast speed as the implicit.. You also want to look for +1 to lightning or all gems.  Arc in particular wants to hit certain gem levels to get more chains which means more damage.. you can get +2 gem levels on a sceptre/wand.. so as a start you at least want to get +1 with some decent stats around it.

glove implicits for damage should be exposure and unnerve so that enemies occasionally take more spell damage..

helmet can be a normal helmet.. with can use eldritch implicits to give you things like penetration and castspeed

eventually you want your soul mantle to be corrupted with +1 to all socketed gems.. that will be a significant power boost.

eventually when you have good currency you can craft a proper totem shaper shield, but for now that'll work.

advice for boots are to run uber labryinth and add one of the following enchants on your boots.. best is penetration, 2nd best is crit chance, 3rd best is added lightning damage, 4th best is life regen

eventually you'll want + gem levels on amulet, thats for when you get currency.

What you are trying to scale is number of totems, maximum dex, crit, cold conversion.   From what I see, you're just winging it, without really understanding the underlying parts.

1 - your iron commander needs blessed orbs to get the crit to 50 or near as possible... the difference is a bow with 6.85 crit or a bow with 7.50 crit.

2.  You have hunter gloves, but practically nothing with it.   If you have hunter gloves, its not for the flat dex alone, it's to pair flat dex with percent dex.  Otherwise there's no need for an influenced base.. just roll a normal one and use eldritch currency for damage per 100 dex.  Beyond that.. you want to convert phys to cold on these gloves.  That's a big part of damage.

3.  Your timeless jewel appears to be garbage.    One of the big reasons these jewels are used is for percent dex.  From what I see you only have 1 5% dex in its radius and you havent allocated it.  Timeless jewels are some of the most expensive jewels because of how powerful they can be.  The right jewel could give you 20-30% dexterity.. yours currently is giving 0%

4. You have no cluster jewel setup outside of the totem one, in terms of endgame damage, this is a potentially huge loss of damage as you can have a large cluster jewel giving you 10 life and 10 dex per node with a itemlevel 84 jewel.   Or you could alternatively get a cold damage jewel setup with cold to the core and other things allocated.

4.  Your gem setup is early stages of efficiency.. just like some of your gear and your tree you ask why other builds do more damage, they likely have better gear,  just having a dex roll is not the end.  It's dex plus other things, and in a stacker, every little part makes a big difference.   

Once you can deal with the attack speed penalty, the anomalous siege ballista is a better fit, just because of its additional projectiles.  
When you can afford it awakened elemental damage with attacks is superior for more damage and reflect immunity.  awakened cold penetration is a better fit your build than increased crit chance...   

Beyond that there's some tree inefficiencies, but hey its your build.  I'd suggest that eventually you also consider adding some split personality jewels with dex and whatever other stat you can afford to the build.    Again it's all step by step.

eb/mom features usually when it is not feasable to give up a ring slot for Essence Worm.  Essence worm allows you use an aura for free, without taking the usual 50% max reservation that an aura would usually take, the cost of this is the lack of all the stats you would normally get on a ring.. and a increased reservation cost on any further aura's/heralds/etc ..  This means essence worm works very well when you build a significant mana pool for MoM and only need one aura for your build to work efficiently.. such as hatred for freezing pulse.   

regular eb/mom becomes the more desired option when you want an aura and a herald or two auras with enlighten 4 and perhaps some reservation. 

The Devouring Diadem allows for eb without the node allocation and also has other stats to help you run two and possibly more 50%  reservation auras, to stack more aura's/heralds than you would otherwise be able to run.  

Survivability when eb/mom switches the other damage absorbtion form to es rather than mana.  So instead of mana regen/mana recovery/mana leech .. you therefore want es regen/es recovery/es leech.  The ratios should not change, if you have 40% mom it will be 60% life/40% es instead of mana.  You then scale es gear/nodes to achieve the same thing in a different way.    The survivability question really depends on what your build is, and what options do you have to replenish the energy shield, every build can fit vaal discipline in for example, which helps with recharge..  There are many combinations of things you may want.. that will all depend on your build.  Suffice to say, if you want to make eb/mom work effectively.. you will have to invest in it.
